summary: Remote-controlled file R/W and agentic shell execution over hardcoded WebSocket in @agenthub-ai/agent
details: When the daemon is started, it opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded server wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound messages to a handler that performs FileRead / FileWrite / FileSearch on arbitrary paths on the installer's host (including Windows drive roots via normalizePath) and drives the Claude Code SDK (documented to run with bypassPermissions) using remote-supplied prompts. A paired remote peer therefore obtains arbitrary file read/write on the host and can execute shell-capable agent tools with the installer's privileges. In addition, an inbound Action.AgentUpdate envelope causes the daemon to spawn its own `update` subcommand, which stops the daemon and runs `npm install -g @agenthub-ai/agent@<latest>` via `cmd.exe /c` before relaunching, giving the remote peer a self-update/persistence channel with no pinning or signature check. The destination endpoint is not user-configurable in the traced code; anyone controlling that endpoint controls the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
